title: An intricate role of Ang II/AT1 in the modulation of monosodium glutamate-induced pulmonary fibrosis by TGF-beta/Smad through quercetin.
authors: Banerjee, Arnab; Das, Debasmita; Manna, Krishnendu; Roy, Jayati; Mukherjee, Sandip; Maji, Bithin Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槲皮素对谷氨酸钠诱导肺纤维化的保护作用，涉及TGF-beta/Smad信号通路和分子对接，但核心是药物-受体结合而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: To investigate the protective actions of the natural flavonoid quercetin against monosodium glutamate (MSG)-induced pulmonary fibrosis in rats, the present study targets the modulation of the TGF-beta/Smad signaling pathway and the involvement of Ang II/AT1. The experimental model involved the treatment of rats with MSG (0.6 g/kg body weight) for 4 weeks and quercetin dosages of 25 mg, 50 mg, and 100 mg/kg body weight. The study applied the combination of biochemical, molecular, and histopathological evaluation to identify the role of quercetin in impacting major cytokines (IL-17, IL-19, TGF-beta, VEGF), oxidative stress markers (TBARS, NO, SOD, CAT, GSH), extracellular matrix components (collagen-I, alpha-SMA, fibronectin), and fibrosis gene expression (TGF-beta1, Smad2/3/4, CTGF, Snail, Slug). MSG treatment increased pro-fibrotic cytokines, oxidative stress, and deposition of collagen in a significant amount, while administration of quercetin dose-dependently reversed the alterations. Quercetin also reversed the activity of antioxidant enzymes, reduced inflammatory cytokines, and inhibited TGF-beta/Smad signaling as indicated by lowered TGF-beta receptor II activation and following Smad phosphorylation. Molecular docking demonstrated that quercetin competitively binds to TGF-beta receptor II to inhibit MSG-induced fibrotic signaling. Quercetin inhibits MSG-induced lung fibrosis by inhibiting collagen accumulation and inflammatory cell invasion and has the potential to produce therapeutic effects by modulating TGF-beta/Smad signaling and restoring lung tissue homeostasis.
abstract_zh: 为探究天然黄酮类化合物槲皮素（quercetin）对大鼠中谷氨酸钠（monosodium glutamate, MSG）诱导的肺纤维化的保护作用，本研究聚焦于TGF-beta/Smad信号通路的调控及Ang II/AT1的参与。实验模型包括用MSG（0.6 g/kg体重）处理大鼠4周，并给予25 mg、50 mg和100 mg/kg体重的槲皮素剂量。研究采用生化、分子和组织病理学评估相结合的方法，以确定槲皮素在影响主要细胞因子（IL-17、IL-19、TGF-beta、VEGF）、氧化应激标志物（TBARS、NO、SOD、CAT、GSH）、细胞外基质成分（胶原蛋白-I、alpha-SMA、纤连蛋白）及纤维化基因表达（TGF-beta1、Smad2/3/4、CTGF、Snail、Slug）中的作用。MSG处理显著增加了促纤维化细胞因子、氧化应激及胶原沉积，而槲皮素给药剂量依赖性地逆转了这些变化。槲皮素还逆转了抗氧化酶的活性，减少了炎症细胞因子，并通过降低TGF-beta受体II激活及随后的Smad磷酸化，抑制了TGF-beta/Smad信号通路。分子对接表明，槲皮素竞争性结合TGF-beta受体II，以抑制MSG诱导的纤维化信号传导。槲皮素通过抑制胶原积累和炎症细胞浸润来抑制MSG诱导的肺纤维化，并可能通过调节TGF-beta/Smad信号通路及恢复肺组织稳态产生治疗效果。
